response.note: Averages latency_ms over non-success attempts from 2024-10-31 to 2026-10-31, assuming a successful status value is 'SUCCESS' (the exact status labels were not specified in the schema).
response.sql: SELECT AVG(latency_ms) AS avg_failed_latency_ms FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE status <> 'SUCCESS' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-10-31' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' LIMIT 50
